description: The Java runtime a vendor ships with a release of its product (cveFeed.java_runtime). An entry is an INFERENCE: the product runs that runtime only if the owner kept it; an installer whose JRE was replaced, an archive install or a container rebuilt on another base runs whatever Java the owner chose. A reading made from this table is never "exact": it is "inferred" (bundled, or the official image) or "weak" (only the vendor's supported Java line). Every entry was read from the vendor's own published page, build file or image definition, cited in "source". Add an entry only from such a source.

products.label: Atlassian Confluence
products.note: the JRE the Linux and Windows installers bundle

products.label: Atlassian Jira
products.note: the JRE the Linux and Windows installers bundle

products.label: Atlassian Bitbucket Data Center
products.note: the Adoptium OpenJDK JRE the installer bundles (from 7.21 and 8.0 the installer always uses it)

products.label: Elasticsearch
products.note: the JDK every Elasticsearch distribution bundles (bundled_jdk in the release tag's build file); ES_JAVA_HOME replaces it

products.label: OpenSearch
products.note: the JDK every OpenSearch distribution bundles (bundled_jdk in the release tag's build file); OPENSEARCH_JAVA_HOME replaces it

products.label: Jenkins (official Docker image)
products.note: the JDK the default jenkins/jenkins image tag runs (a -jdkNN tag or another install runs another)

products.label: Keycloak (official container image)
products.note: the OpenJDK package the quay.io/keycloak/keycloak image installs on its Red Hat UBI base

products.label: SonarQube (official Docker image)
products.note: the Eclipse Temurin base of the official sonarqube image (the zip distribution runs the Java the owner installed)

products.label: Atlassian Bamboo Data Center
products.note: Bamboo bundles no JRE: the Java lines its supported platforms page lists for the release

products.label: Atlassian Crowd
products.note: Crowd bundles no JRE: the Java line its supported platforms page lists for the release

jenkins_minimum.note: The oldest Java the Jenkins controller starts on, by release: a hard minimum (an older Java does not run it), never the Java it runs
